verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Hugging Face publishes some of its own code publicly, such as the huggingface_hub client repo on GitHub, and community comments describe its Transformers, accelerate and datasets libraries as open source. Nothing documents a specific license, and nothing shows the core Hub platform's source is readable. missing for 10: explicit open-license documentation (e.g., Apache/MIT terms), evidence that the Hub/platform source itself is open, first-party docs on source availability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Hugging Face have been a great open source steward of Transformers
HF's accelerate, transformers and datasets are "some of the worst open source Python libraries I have ever used."
